a.lede: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.
a.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more

b.lede: Google plans to help turn those personal AI-generated apps into wide releases.
b.title: Google wants to host your personal vibe-coded apps in the Play Store
